name: Delivery for Marin
summary: Sprinkle in Gadgetzan hands you the Violet Powder to carry to Marin Noggenfogger, along with a reminder that Marin owes her a favor.

sections.title: A Town Delivery
sections.body: With the Violet Tragan in hand, Sprinkle gives you the Violet Powder to take to Marin Noggenfogger, who is also in Gadgetzan. You are to tell Marin that a favor is owed to her.

faq.q: Who sends you to Marin Noggenfogger?
faq.answer: Sprinkle, in Gadgetzan, gives you the Violet Powder after you bring her the Violet Tragan.
Violet Powder, which Sprinkle gives you to carry to Marin Noggenfogger.
In Gadgetzan, the same town as Sprinkle.

faq.q: What message does Sprinkle want passed to Marin?
aliases: what does sprinkle say to marin
faq.answer: She wants Marin told that he owes her a favor.
